content.body:
Hey all, I'm Awad, a TC39 delegate (Sentry) and I maintain our browser + Node tracing SDKs. 

On the Node side I've been driving native `diagnostics_channel.TracingChannel` adoption across the ecosystem (redis/ioredis, mongoose, graphql-js, Vercel AI, express, and other libs/frameworks).

I'd like to help, specifically where a tracing SDK has evidence you can use. I will familiarize myself with the open issues and discussions, is there a regular meeting to discuss progress? I haven't been able to locate it.
